name: Input
description: Input VCF file to subset. For bgzip-compressed input (.vcf.gz), also provide the companion tabix index (.tbi).

name: Reference Genome
description: Reference genome FASTA and required companion index files. All three files must correspond to the same reference used for alignment and variant calling.

name: Output
description: Name for the output VCF file containing the selected variants.

name: Selection Filters
description: Criteria for selecting variants: by type, JEXL expression, filtering status, allele management, or sample identity.

name: Advanced Options
description: Pass additional GATK arguments or a GATK configuration file. Use the arguments file to specify options not exposed as explicit parameters (e.g., --java-options, --tmp-dir, multiple --sample-name or --select-type-to-include entries).
